The real Fitter summary showed Total DSP Blocks 0 / 1,687 and a floating-point datapath (FPAddSub, with an alignment shifter) built from LUTs/ALMs: the premise was wrong and the IP is a soft implementation (#472).
soft_units.verified_on_actual_hardware: Real Quartus build clean (Flow Status Successful); 568 ALM; 158.88 MHz on clk_div against a 25 MHz target; two real operations (A=0xAAAA0001, B=0x55550002 first): fire asserted, result read back matching the test's deterministic pattern, ACK cleared fire, and the wrapper re-armed for the second operation (#472).
soft_units.function_note: An IEEE-754 FLOATING-POINT datapath. It is NOT an integer multiplier, so it is not a drop-in for the assembler's integer `mul` core; it is recorded here as a known-working soft DSP on this card. The hard-DSP alternative ('Native Floating Point DSP Intel Arria 10 FPGA IP') was never chosen and remains undecided (#472, #475).
